title: Recall Objective Map
user: A self-learner starting a broad topic who needs every review prompt tied to a stated learning objective and visible evidence of what they can actually explain.
smallest_useful_product: Offline PWA with an objective tree, manual evidence tags (explain, solve, recognize), a one-question recall check, and an exportable weekly weak-skill map.
success_measure: In a four-week pilot, 60% of users attach 20+ recall checks to objectives and can name their two weakest objectives without opening a card browser.
constraints: Local-first storage and export; no claims that recall score measures mastery; accessibility for keyboard-only review.
